What we treat

Two disciplines, one visit.

A few of the treatments patients come to Charm Esthetic for — ask us about a plan built around what you actually want to change.

Dental

  • ＋Exams & cleaningsRoutine checkups and hygiene to keep small issues small.
  • ＋Teeth whiteningIn-clinic brightening for a cleaner, more confident smile.
  • ＋Smile design & veneersShape, align and finish a smile you'd want in every photo.
  • ＋OrthodonticsBraces and clear aligner options for adults and teens.
  • ＋Implants & restorationsReplacing what's missing so the rest works like it should.

Skin & Aesthetics

  • ＋Skin consultationsA read on your skin and a plan that fits its actual needs.
  • ＋Deep facials & signature treatmentsResurfacing work for texture, tone and lasting glow.
  • ＋Lip fillerSubtle, considered shaping — natural results are the goal.
  • ＋Acne treatmentClearing active breakouts and calming what's left behind.
  • ＋Skin rejuvenationSoftening fine lines and refreshing tired-looking skin.
